sources.title: Amuzgos — historical orientation
sources.publisher: Secretaría de Cultura, Sistema de Información Cultural
sources.annotation: Short government historical orientation, centered substantially on Xochistlahuaca. Retained as supporting context rather than filling the substantive target. Its oral-history account is not a dated archaeological sequence; numerical estimates are not adopted as current figures.
sources.contentReviewScope: Actual Presentación, crafts/festivals paragraphs and update metadata read. The linked INPI monograph and audiovisual materials were not inspected through this card; direct Atlas opening failed.

sections.title: Keeping historical guides local and dated
sections.text: The cultural-information guide’s historical account focuses substantially on Xochistlahuaca, linking colonial administration and dispossession with later land-recovery efforts. It also labels its origin account as oral history. This brief government synthesis provides orientation; it cannot substitute for community histories, establish a dated migration sequence or describe every Amuzgo settlement’s experience.
